artifacts.summary: Eight-phase, fully sequential plan to rewrite <sec:representation> in typst/FormalFoundations.typ as a positive development of the TM-plus representation theorem, with cross-reference, bibliography, and compile/sync-check verification.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, typst prose edits are gated by scripts/typst-sync-check.sh Check 1, which greps EVERY backticked span in typst/**/*.typ (excluding generated/) against live Lean source with `grep -rl --include=*.lean --exclude-dir=Boneyard -F`. The #leansrc(module, name) helper builds a raw block from plain string arguments, so its arguments are NOT backticks in the .typ source and are NOT scanned. Consequence for planning any typst rewrite that cites Lean: backticked identifiers in prose are hard-gated and must resolve or be whitelisted in typst/sync-check-whitelist.txt, whereas #leansrc tags carry no such gate and must be verified by hand against actual module paths (which drift -- e.g. multiFamTaskFrameGen lives in Metalogic.BXCanonical.CompletenessDedekind, not Metalogic.Algebraic).
